# TraininGenie

TraininGenie is a corporate learning and development partner serving organizations in India and beyond. The website publishes information about corporate training, technology learning, leadership development, management systems, ISO standards, governance, risk, and compliance learning.

## Official website

- Homepage: https://www.trainingenie.com/
- Training catalogue: https://www.trainingenie.com/corporate-training-services
- Contact: https://www.trainingenie.com/contact-us
- About: https://www.trainingenie.com/about-us
- Founder profile: https://www.trainingenie.com/our-team
- Clients: https://www.trainingenie.com/clients-and-testimonials
- FAQs: https://www.trainingenie.com/faqs
- Sitemap: https://www.trainingenie.com/sitemap.xml
